newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust names managing director.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust names managing director.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp said it named Kevin Ferrell as managing director and head of its risk-management advisory business.
Ferrell will also take responsibility for client coverage in Bankers Trust's oil and gas industry group.
Ferrell was previously chief financial officer of McKesson Corp. McKesson announced his resignation on August 28.
It could not immediately be determined if Ferrell is taking a newly created position or if he is replacing someone at Bankers Trust.

Later on Wednesday, Bankers Trust spokesman Alan Hanson said Ferrell would take some of Lee Barba's responsiblities, Barba will continue as head of the financial services, technology and operations group,
Ferrell will take the oil and gas client coverage responsiblities from Michael Walsh, who covers other industries at the firm, Hanson said.
